nodes.label: Model
nodes.desc: Abstract hub of every NeMo model: typed I/O contracts, serialization, save/restore and from_pretrained model registry.

nodes.label: ModelPT
nodes.desc: LightningModule base for all classic NeMo models: config-driven init, data/optimizer setup, .nemo save and restore.

nodes.label: NeuralType
nodes.desc: Semantic type system that type-checks the tensors flowing between neural modules.

nodes.label: SaveRestoreConnector
nodes.desc: Pluggable connector that packs and unpacks model YAML + weights into .nemo archives.

nodes.label: Exportable
nodes.desc: Mixin giving models export hooks for ONNX and TorchScript deployment formats.

nodes.label: ASRModel
nodes.desc: Abstract speech-recognition base: aux-loss registry, WER plumbing, CUDA-graph toggles and model listing.

nodes.label: ConformerEncoder
nodes.desc: Streaming-capable Conformer encoder built from typed neural modules; the workhorse front-end of Parakeet-class models.

nodes.label: SpectrogramGenerator
nodes.desc: Abstract text-to-spectrogram base that normalizes text, tokenizes it and exposes generate_spectrogram.

nodes.label: SALM
nodes.desc: Speech-Aware Language Model: an HF-style LightningModule that interleaves audio tokens with text for multimodal LLM training.

nodes.label: SentencePieceTokenizer
nodes.desc: Shared SentencePiece/BPE tokenizer used across ASR, TTS and speech-language collections.

nodes.label: CallbackGroup
nodes.desc: Singleton that fans NeMo lifecycle hooks out to every registered BaseCallback.

nodes.label: exp_manager
nodes.desc: One-call setup of loggers, checkpointing and resume logic around a Lightning Trainer.
